Workflows.title: Primary Business Workflow
Workflows.goal: Verify users can browse and add products to the cart
Workflows.feature_area: Online fashion and accessories retail store
agent_activity_summary: The agent initiated the scenario by navigating to the homepage of atid.store. It successfully located and clicked the 'Shop Now' button to enter the shopping flow. The agent then selected the first product, 'Boho Bangle Bracelet', and proceeded to its product details page. On this page, the agent identified and clicked the 'Add to cart' button. However, upon attempting to proceed further, the agent encountered an HTTP ERROR 429, which prevented completion of the intended shopping workflow.
agent_activity_error: At Step 5, the agent encountered a hard blocker: HTTP ERROR 429 (Too Many Requests) after attempting to add the product to the cart. This error prevented further progress and completion of the scenario. No recovery was possible, and the agent documented the partial completion in the final report.
agent_activity_outcome: The agent was unable to complete the full user scenario due to a blocking HTTP ERROR 429 after adding the product to the cart. The intended goal of completing the shopping flow was not achieved.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: Investigate and resolve the HTTP 429 error by reviewing server rate limits or implementing request throttling. Consider adding retry logic or increasing wait times between actions to avoid triggering rate limits during automated testing. Re-run the scenario after addressing these issues to validate end-to-end flow.
test_steps: Click the 'Shop Now' button to begin shopping
Select the first product 'Boho Bangle Bracelet'
Click 'Add to cart' to add the product to the shopping cart
